from resize_guard import check_same_shape

def test_equal_shapes_no_raise():
    """Test that equal shapes do not raise ValueError."""
    # Test with 2D shapes
    check_same_shape((10, 20), (10, 20))
    
    # Test with 3D shapes (extra dimensions ignored)
    check_same_shape((10, 20, 3), (10, 20, 5))
    
    # Test with different extra dimensions
    check_same_shape((10, 20, 3, 4), (10, 20, 7, 8))

def test_differing_height_raises():
    """Test that differing height raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="shape.*does not match original"):
        check_same_shape((10, 20), (15, 20))

def test_differing_width_raises():
    """Test that differing width raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="shape.*does not match original"):
        check_same_shape((10, 20), (10, 25))"}
